name: Coinbase
basis: each funding- or dividend-inclusive history is scaled to its own latest raw USD close

fundingForecast.displaySign: positive is earned by a perp long; negative is paid by a perp long

onchainSpot.preferenceBasis: all pages display separate CEX reported-volume and contract-backed DEX execution sections
onchainSpot.volumeSource: direct Binance, Bitget, Bybit, OKX, and Meteora venue APIs plus factory-verified PancakeSwap V3 pool-event volume indexed by DexScreener; DEX quote routes without indexed pool-event volume are excluded
onchainSpot.liquiditySource: direct CEX order books; direct Ethereum, Robinhood-chain, and PancakeSwap V3 quoter depth; direct Meteora pool state; and direct Jupiter executable round-trip quotes

cexMarkets.pair: No listed COIN tokenized spot pair

peerMapping.justification: The block is built as long COIN against a short peer basket plus the XYZ100 hedge. Direct crypto-linked economics drive the largest weights: CRCL and MSTR carry 0.625 combined because their revenues or balance-sheet value are most exposed to crypto-asset prices, trading activity, and speculative positioning. NVDA, AMD, TSLA, and PLTR fill out the high-beta growth and retail-risk factor that COIN also exhibits, but they are capped because their business models are less comparable. All liquidity references use the displayed 24-hour perp liquidity in USD millions; COIN is 0.71 USD millions, so the basket avoids overloading very large but less similar names and keeps the smallest weights on TSLA and PLTR. Peer weights are positive and sum to exactly 1.

peers.name: Circle Internet Group
peers.reason: Circle Internet Group is the closest economic peer because stablecoin infrastructure and crypto transaction activity share the same digital-asset adoption and revenue cycle as Coinbase. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 1.655 USD millions, above COIN at 0.710 USD millions, so it receives the largest peer weight.

peers.name: Strategy
peers.reason: Strategy is the next best peer because its equity value is closely tied to bitcoin holdings and crypto risk appetite, which also drive Coinbase trading volume and custody economics. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 1.484 USD millions, comfortably above COIN at 0.710 USD millions, supporting a large but secondary weight.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: NVIDIA adds high-beta growth and momentum exposure that often trades with the same risk appetite as Coinbase, but its semiconductor business is less economically comparable; its 24-hour perp liquidity is 3.384 USD millions, so the weight is capped below the crypto-native peers.

peers.name: Tesla
peers.reason: Tesla is not a crypto company, but it overlaps with Coinbase through retail speculative positioning and high-beta growth factor exposure; with 24-hour perp liquidity of 4.551 USD millions, it is liquid enough for a meaningful but still secondary weight.

peers.name: Palantir Technologies
peers.reason: Palantir is not a crypto company, but it is a high-beta software name that can transmit the same speculative growth and retail-risk factor that often moves COIN. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 0.544 USD millions, below COIN at 0.710 USD millions, so the weight is kept moderate.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: XYZ100 is the cleanest primary hedge because COIN trades mainly as a high-beta growth and risk-appetite stock. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 21.944 USD millions, which is deep for an intra-TradeXYZ hedge while keeping the exposure closer to growth-factor moves than a broad market gauge.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; basket rebased to the target spot level at the first overlapping date

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by each peer's latest USD cash close; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot close

earningsOptions.source: Schwab listed-options chain, FMP earnings calendars, and Sharadar adjusted prices

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with FMP historical calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
